criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: Information Request
categories.definition: User seeks information about COVID-19, including symptoms, transmission, and statistics.

categories.name: Treatment Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about treatments, cures, or remedies for COVID-19.

categories.name: Vaccine Inquiry
categories.definition: User inquires about the availability, effectiveness, or details of COVID-19 vaccines.

categories.name: Safety Precautions
categories.definition: User seeks advice on how to stay safe or prevent infection from COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel Concerns
categories.definition: User asks about travel safety, restrictions, or guidelines related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Myth Debunking
categories.definition: User seeks clarification or debunking of myths related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Updates and News
categories.definition: User requests the latest news or updates regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Community Support
categories.definition: User expresses a desire to donate or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Personal Experience
categories.definition: User shares personal symptoms or experiences related to COVID-19.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks general questions or makes casual remarks not specifically related to COVID-19.
